name: Rent Top Apartments Rambla Catalunya
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Rent Top Apartments Rambla Catalunya. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Featuring free WiFi and air conditioning, Rent Top Apartments Rambla Catalunya 8 is located in Barcelona, 200 metres from Plaça Catalunya. Portal de l'Angel is 500 metres from the property.

The accommodation has a seating area. Some units feature a dining area and/or terrace. There is also a kitchen, equipped with a dishwasher. An oven, a toaster and refrigerator are also offered, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle.

Casa Batllo is 500 metres from Rambla Catalunya 8. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 13 km from the property.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.9 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

policies.title: Cancellation/ prepayment
policies.content: Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to accommodation type. Please check what conditions may apply to each option when making your selection.

policies.title: Refundable damage deposit
policies.content: A damage deposit of € 300 is required. The property charges this 7 days before arrival. That's about US$351. This will be collected by credit card. You should be reimbursed within 7 days of check-out. Your deposit will be refunded in full via credit card, subject to an inspection of the property.

policies.title: Children and beds
policies.content: Child policies Children of any age are welcome. Children 3 years and above will be charged as adults at this property. To see correct prices and occupancy information, please add the number of children in your group and their ages to your search. Cot and extra bed policies 0 - 2 years Cot upon request 3+ years Extra bed upon request Prices for cots are not included in the total price, and will have to be paid for separately during your stay. The number of cots allowed is dependent on the option you choose. Please check your selected option for more information. There are no extra beds available at this property. All cots are subject to availability.

hostInfo.name: Rent Top Apartments
hostInfo.welcomeMessage: These completely exclusive apartments combine great taste and style with the original antiquity and story of this remarkable Barcelona building located in the heart of the city at only 200 meters from Catalunya Square. After a long day the fabulous interior and atmosphere is incredibly relaxing and replenishing. The apartments are completely equipped with everything you need to feel at home away from home.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Rent Top Apartments is a premier provider of quality short term furnished apartment rentals in Barcelona.
Whatever the purpose of your trip, business or pleasure, we pride ourselves in providing hotel-alternative housing solutions, high quality apartments in the best location in the city.
We are a customer-focused team and strive to offer the highest level of service. Our dynamic and multicultural staff works to help you find the apartment you are looking for.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: If you are keen to explore everything Barcelona centre has to offer this is definitely the choice for you. The bustling Las Ramblas starts just the other side of the square. Also, just on the doorstep are Paseo de Gracia, Rambla Catalunya, Plaza Universitat and the main shopping street Portal del Angel. You can get around the city easily with bus, metro and taxi station all in the vicinity. If you prefer to wander around on foot this is perfect to discover the winding streets of the Gothic and Raval quarters or see the Cathedral or Picasso museum in the fashionable Borne district.
